config.label: Your LexVibe app id (used in the installed snippet and API calls)
config.description: Your LexVibe app id (used in the installed snippet and API calls). Optional: if unset, tools ask for the id explicitly and warn about the placeholder.

config.label: Base URL of the LexVibe API
config.description: Base URL of the LexVibe API. Only needed for self-hosting / development.

config.label: Base URL the widget script is served from
config.description: Base URL the widget script is served from. Only needed for self-hosting / development (defaults to the LexVibe CDN, or to LEXVIBE_API_URL when that is set).

config.label: Endpoint that receives anonymous tool-usage events (mcp_tool_call) for the Platform analytics
config.description: Endpoint that receives anonymous tool-usage events (mcp_tool_call) for the Platform analytics. Defaults to the LexVibe events endpoint (or LEXVIBE_API_URL + /api/events when LEXVIBE_API_URL is set). Only needed for self-hosting.

config.label: Set to 0/false/off to disable anonymous usage telemetry
config.description: Set to 0/false/off to disable anonymous usage telemetry. DO_NOT_TRACK=1 is also honored.
